principle: A render recipe may be emitted only when every render-relevant relationship and runtime parameter required by the target frame is directly evidenced. Unknowns stay unknown; they are never filled by approximation, aesthetic judgement, filename proximity, bundle co-membership, or model inference.

evidenceClasses.serialized_exact: Direct Unity serialized PPtr/object reference or exact TypeTree field linking the concrete objects.
evidenceClasses.runtime_observed: Runtime state directly observed/traced for the target screen/frame, including values and activation state.
evidenceClasses.clr_exact: Compiled IL/code establishes the behavior or assignment unambiguously; runtime-dependent values still require observation when they affect pixels.
evidenceClasses.catalog_exact: gameres/offset catalog proves storage, identity, extraction coordinates or bundle dependency only; it does NOT prove per-object visual use.
evidenceClasses.historical_exact: Previously captured exact evidence for the same game build/object identity; current-build identity must be revalidated.
evidenceClasses.candidate: Search score, basename match, path family, proximity, heuristic, likely relation or model inference. Forbidden in certified recipes.

requiredClosure: exact root screen/prefab/scene identity for the target frame
complete active GameObject hierarchy relevant to pixels
Transform/RectTransform values: parent, localPosition/rotation/scale, anchors, pivot, sizeDelta, sibling order
active/enabled state of renderers, canvases, graphics, cameras, lights and behaviours
Renderer/Graphic -> Mesh/Sprite -> Material exact serialized references
Material -> Shader and all pixel-affecting material properties, keywords, render queue, blend/depth/cull state
Material/Graphic -> Texture/Sprite exact references including atlas, sprite rect, borders, UV/packing/rotation where applicable
Mesh submeshes, material slot order, skin/bones/blendshapes when relevant
Animator/controller/clip/state/layer/time/speed/parameters and the exact sampled frame when animation affects pixels
Camera projection, fieldOfView/orthographicSize, transform, viewport, aspect, near/far, culling mask, clear flags/background, physical camera settings and camera stack
Lighting and render-pipeline settings that affect the target: lights, SH/global shader parameters, shadows, URP asset/renderer features
RenderTexture dimensions/format/filter/wrap/MSAA and exact producer/consumer chain
post-processing/image effects including blur algorithm, passes, sigma/radius/iterations/downsample and ordering
runtime-created or runtime-reparented objects and their exact target-frame state
dynamic data driving text, icons, heroes, power values, skins, levels, visibility and localization
Canvas scaler/reference resolution, actual viewport, safe area, device aspect and any crop/letterbox behavior
sorting layers/orders, canvas order, depth and stencil/mask hierarchy
all unresolved external assets/dependencies closed to concrete objects used by the target
target-frame visual verification against an original reference captured from the same screen/state/build
certificationRules: No candidate edge may participate in a certified render chain.
Catalog-level bundle dependency may be used for extraction discovery but cannot satisfy a composition edge.
If any pixel-affecting field is unknown, the recipe status is not certified.
If a runtime value can vary and was not observed for the target frame, the recipe status is not certified.
No default Unity value may be assumed unless the serialized/runtime evidence explicitly proves that value for the target.
No visual substitution, hand placement, guessed blur, guessed crop, guessed color, guessed texture, guessed transform or guessed animation timing is permitted.
A certified recipe must cite the evidence source for every render-relevant edge/value.
Final certification requires comparison to an original reference; discrepancies must be explained by proven device/compression differences or certification is withheld.

verification.preferred: pixel-aligned reference comparison on the same viewport/aspect and target state
verification.rule: The comparison is validation, not a source for inventing missing implementation details.
verification.result: Any unexplained structural mismatch blocks CERTIFIED_PIXEL_FAITHFUL status.
